title: Get ready: New resources for data brokers related to deletion request processing
discussion_signal: The regulator's post presents DROP as a centralized deletion route and sets a processing date for data brokers. The social signal is institutional: privacy control becomes more observable through a shared request mechanism, while the post does not establish whether broker-side deletion is durable or complete.
linked_research_question: When privacy rights are centralized into one request route, does that create durable consumer control or only a more visible request process?
limits: An agency announcement does not measure completion rates or broker compliance
The post does not expose individual user outcomes
Centralized request submission is not proof of durable deletion
